property.description: SimpleThreshold functions do not panic under appropriate assumptions.

rules.name: set_threshold_non_panic
rules.description: if storage is setup, setting a valid threshold and account_id is auth, then set_threshold does not panic

rules.name: get_threshold_non_panic
rules.description: if storage is setup, threshold exists, then get_threshold does not panic

rules.name: can_enforce_non_panic
rules.description: if storage is setup can_enforce does not panic

rules.name: enforce_non_panic
rules.description: if storage_is_setup, can_enforce returns true, and account_id is auth, then enforce does not panic

rules.name: install_non_panic
rules.description: if storage is setup, account_id is auth, setting a valid threshold, then install does not panic

rules.name: uninstall_non_panic
rules.description: if storage is setup, account_id is auth, then uninstall does not panic
